title: Liquid-liquid extraction of 3,3'-dichlorobiphenyl (PCB11) from animal blood/serum
author: Xueshu Li
materials: Cap tube-A and the Reference standard .
Invert tube-B for 5 min and centrifuge.
Invert tube-A on the tube rotator and centrifuge.

steps.title: Collect and label blood/serum
steps.instruction: Collect whole blood (0.3‑0.5 g) or serum (~0.2 g) into tube‑A, label (A1, A2, …), record weight on the working sheet, and store on ice.

steps.title: Spike surrogate standards in tube‑A
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL of SS_PCB (d‑PCB65, 100 ng mL⁻¹) and 100 µL of SS_PCB (PCB14, 100 ng mL⁻¹) to each tube‑A to deliver 10 ng of each PCB.

steps.title: Add acid and hexane
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL 6 M HCl to tube‑A, vortex 10 s; then add 3 mL hexane with a repeat pipettor and vortex.

steps.title: Prepare work area
steps.instruction: Set up ice box, serological pipettes and fume hood; ensure all glassware is combusted and silica gel, glass wool, etc. are ready.

steps.title: Prepare SPE cartridges
steps.instruction: Place glass wool at the bottom of each SPE cartridge, add 0.2 g silica gel and 2 g acidified silica gel, then rinse with 3 mL hexane:DCM (1:1).

steps.title: Spike internal standards
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL IS mixture (PCB30 + PCB204, 100 ng mL⁻¹) to each tube‑E and to the Reference standard (delivers 10 ng each).

steps.title: Spike hydroxyl‑PCBs
steps.instruction: Add 100 µL SS_OH‑PCB (4′‑OH‑PCB159, 100 ng mL⁻¹) to each tube‑A (10 ng each).

steps.title: Spike PCB11 and OH‑PCB11
steps.instruction: To tube‑A OPR samples and the Reference standard add 100 µL PCB11 standard (100 ng mL⁻¹) and 100 µL OH‑PCB11 mixture (100 ng mL⁻¹) delivering 10 ng each.

steps.title: Transfer organic phase A→B→C
steps.instruction: Using a short glass pipette, transfer the top (organic) layer from tube‑A to tube‑B, then from tube‑B to tube‑C.

steps.title: Add diazomethane
steps.instruction: Add ~0.5 mL diazomethane to each sample tube (A‑E) and 1 mL to the Reference standard using a 10 mL serological pipette.

steps.title: Derivatization incubation
steps.instruction: Cap all tubes, store at 4‑8 °C for ≥3 h (or overnight, ~16 h).

steps.title: Evaporate reference standard
steps.instruction: Evaporate the Reference standard to near dryness (~50 µL) and set aside for later IS spiking.

steps.title: Remove excess ether/diazomethane
steps.instruction: In a fume hood, evaporate excess ether and diazomethane under gentle N₂ flow until ~200 µL remains (no yellow colour).

steps.title: Base hydrolysis
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL 95 % KOH in ethanol to each tube, vortex, then heat at 50 °C water bath for 1 h, vortexing ≈ every 15 min.

steps.title: Aqueous work‑up
steps.instruction: Add 7 mL Mili‑Q water, invert, then centrifuge 5 min at 3000 rpm; invert tubes on rotator 5 min at 40 rpm if needed.

steps.title: Hexane rinse of tube‑E
steps.instruction: Rinse tube‑E with ~150 µL hexane, combine the rinse with the tube‑E extract in a GC‑vial insert to a final volume of ~300 µL.

steps.title: Load extracts onto SPE
steps.instruction: Using long glass pipettes, slowly load extracts from tube‑D onto the SPE cartridges, adjust vacuum so eluate drips drop‑by‑drop, keep solvent level above silica gel.

steps.title: Replace waste tubes
steps.instruction: Replace bottom waste tubes with freshly labeled combusted tube‑E, aligning tube‑D order with tube‑E order.

steps.title: Standard processing conditions
steps.instruction: All centrifugations: 5 min at 3000 rpm; all inversions: 5 min at 40 rpm; nitrogen evaporation may use a 35 °C water bath if needed.

steps.title: Evaporate tube‑A extract
steps.instruction: Evaporate the solvent from tube‑A under gentle N₂ to ~0.5 mL.

steps.title: Rinse tube‑D with solvent
steps.instruction: Rinse tube‑D twice with 0.5 mL hexane:DCM (1:1), passing each rinse through the SPE cartridge.

steps.title: Elute with hexane:DCM
steps.instruction: Repeatedly add hexane:DCM (1:1) to the SPE cartridge (total ≈9 mL) until the eluate in tube‑E reaches 10 mL.

steps.title: Add KCl to tube‑A blanks
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL of 1 % KCl solution to tube‑A containing blank samples (or 3 mL to tube‑B as required).

steps.title: Add 2‑propanol and MTBE mixture
steps.instruction: Add 5 mL 2‑propanol to tube‑A, vortex 10 s; then add 5 mL hexane‑MTBE (1:1 v/v) to tube‑A and cap with PTFE‑septum caps.

steps.title: Re‑extract tube‑B
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL hexane to tube‑B, vortex, centrifuge, then transfer the organic layer to tube‑C.

steps.title: Evaporate tube‑C extract
steps.instruction: Evaporate solvent from tube‑C under gentle N₂ to ~100 µL (do not dry).

steps.title: Prepare solvent blank
steps.instruction: Fill a GC vial with the same hexane used for extractions to serve as a solvent blank.

steps.title: Label all sample tubes
steps.instruction: Label tubes A, B, C, D, and E clearly; also label GC vials.

steps.title: Set aside Reference standard
steps.instruction: Place the Reference standard aside for the later derivatization step.

steps.title: Re‑extract tube‑A
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL hexane‑MTBE (1:1), vortex 10 s, centrifuge, and keep the extract for further processing.

steps.title: Warm analytical standards
steps.instruction: Remove OPR and surrogate standards from the freezer and allow to warm to room temperature (~30 min).

steps.title: Collect blood in EDTA
steps.instruction: If whole blood is used, collect into tubes containing 80 µL 7.5 % w/w EDTA, store at –20 °C until extraction.

steps.title: Turn on water bath
steps.instruction: Set the water bath to 50 °C.

steps.title: Warm internal standards
steps.instruction: Remove IS standards from freezer and let warm to room temperature (~30 min).

steps.title: Prepare fresh KOH‑EtOH solution
steps.instruction: Make fresh 95 % KOH in ethanol solution for the base‑cleanup step.

steps.title: Bench sit, centrifuge, combine with tube‑D
steps.instruction: Let samples sit on the bench 15 min, centrifuge, then transfer the top layer (~5 mL) to tube‑D.

steps.title: Add hexane to tube‑C
steps.instruction: Add 2 mL hexane to tube‑C and vortex.

steps.title: Transfer tube‑C layer to tube‑D
steps.instruction: Using a short pipette, transfer the top layer from tube‑C to tube‑D.

steps.title: Prepare silica gel suspension
steps.instruction: In a small beaker, mix hexane:DCM (1:1) with acidified silica gel (5:1), swirl, then add the suspension onto the silica gel in each SPE cartridge with a short pipette.

steps.title: Assemble SPE manifold
steps.instruction: Add uncombusted waste tubes to the bottom of the SPE manifold; add 0.2 g silica gel (via combusted funnel) and glass wool to each cartridge, pack down, replace the top, and place cartridges into ports.

steps.title: Rinse SPE cartridges
steps.instruction: Rinse each SPE cartridge with 2 mL hexane:DCM (1:1) using a long pipette; then let silica gel precipitate and pass ~3 mL hexane:DCM (1:1) into the bottom waste tube, keeping solvent above the acidified silica gel.

steps.title: Concentrate tube‑E extracts
steps.instruction: Add 3 mL hexane to tube‑E and concentrate under gentle N₂ to ~50 µL (do not dry); then further concentrate to ~200 µL as needed.

steps.title: Finalize SPE and collect eluate
steps.instruction: Turn off the manifold vacuum, remove tube‑E, vortex, and transfer extracts from tube‑E and the Reference standard into combusted crimp‑style GC vials with inserts using a long pipette.

steps.title: Dispose of waste
steps.instruction: Dispose of SPE cartridges, glassware, solvents, and PCB‑containing items according to the detailed waste categories (PCB waste, organic hazardous waste, aqueous hazardous waste, glass hazard container).

steps.title: Store final extracts
steps.instruction: Cap all GC vials with crimp caps, store in a solvent‑proof –20 °C freezer until analysis (do not use a regular freezer).

steps.title: Handle diazomethane safely
steps.instruction: Remove the diazomethane vial from the freezer and place it in an ice box inside the fume hood before use.

steps.title: Add final KCl to tube‑A
steps.instruction: Add 1 % KCl solution to the remaining tube‑A to a final volume of ~3 mL (do not add to the Reference standard).

steps.title: Add methanol to tube‑C
steps.instruction: Add 5 drops methanol to tube‑C (except the Reference standard) and vortex 5 s.
